title: Ezekiel Saw the Wheel
transcription:
Ezekiel Saw the Wheel

Ezekiel saw the wheel rollin' way in the
middle of the air.
A wheel within a wheel rollin' way in
the middle of the air.
And the big wheel ran by faith,
and the little wheel ran
by the grace a' God,
Ezekiel saw the wheel rollin' way in the
middle of the air.
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription from a clear two-page scan. Some small instructional text and dialect spellings may need verification.
